sloka: तस्मिन्नुपरते शब्दे दिव्ये श्रोतृ(त्र)सुखे नृणाम् ।ददर्श भारतं सैन्यं विधानं विश्वकर्मण: ॥ २.९१.२८॥
transliteration: tasminnuparate śabde divye śrotṛ(tra)sukhe nṛṇām ।dadarśa bhārataṁ sainyaṁ vidhānaṁ viśvakarmaṇa: ॥ 2.91.28॥

translations.english: When the celestial sounds pleasing to the ears of men had subsided, the army of Bharata beheld the wonderful creations of Visvakarma.
